correctness.rationale: Two reflection matchings with distinct centers form an acyclic edge union by a nonzero-translation argument; uniform labeling yields q^-(r+s) exact joint radius tails. A three-symbol-window variance calculation proves the converse. Nested same-center tail events give every covariance formula; tail-sum moments and a summable geometric truncation deficit give the mean and variance slopes. Full proof boundaries were checked, with 13,735 exact finite assertions independently recomputed from raw words and forests.

originality.rationale: The direct accessible primary source gives only one-point expectation for positional palindrome occurrence counts; the closest overlapping-pair paper uses fixed-length reverse-complement DNA patterns. The new exact pairwise independence of all maximal radii for ordinary iid words, uniform-only characterization, cross-parity covariance matrix and variance asymptotic are not implied by the inspected statements as a whole. Searches of published records returned different invariants, and priority is qualified by a directly relevant inaccessible 2013 full text and possible older implicit formulas.

value.rationale: The all-length palindrome-occurrence covariance matrix and a complete uniform-only independence characterization address a natural second-order random-word gap after classical first-moment formulas. The exact parity splitting, non-mutual independence and finite-to-asymptotic variance calculation offer substantive structural information for palindrome frequency statistics, not isolated examples.
